activities.anchor: Those are not moods; those are data points
activities.caption: pair each clinical vignette with the route it demonstrates
activities.name: mtRouteMatch

config.prompt: Four clinical pictures, four routes from music to change. Pair them:

pairs.left: a stroke patient walks to a metronomic beat with a steadier stride
pairs.right: entrainment — a steady beat pulls the body's oscillators toward it

pairs.left: a man with advanced Alzheimer's sings every word of songs from his twenties
pairs.right: melody reaches memory — widely stored musical memory

pairs.left: a child with autism, silent in conversation, takes a turn in a drumming exchange
non-fluent aphasia re-trained by setting phrases to simple melody

config.why: The therapist's craft is knowing which route reaches which system — choosing the musical intervention like a clinician chooses a drug: targeted, dosed and evaluated.

activities.anchor: The profession's founding story is medical and surprisingly recent
activities.caption: scrub the profession's first half-century
activities.name: mtHistoryTimeline

events.title: The first degree program
events.text: The first university music therapy degree program begins at Michigan State University.

events.title: NAMT founded
events.text: The National Association for Music Therapy follows the veterans' hospitals' demand for musicians trained in clinical method.

events.title: MT-BC credential
events.text: The Certification Board for Music Therapists is established — the board examination that still defines entry to practice in the United States.

events.title: AMTA merger
events.text: The two American associations merge into the American Music Therapy Association.

activities.anchor: The research base has grown in layers
activities.caption: stack the evidence from strongest to thinnest
activities.name: mtEvidenceOrder

config.prompt: The profession matches interventions to the evidence gradient. Order it:
items: Strongest: rhythmic auditory stimulation for gait in Parkinson's disease and stroke
Solid: music therapy as an add-on to standard care in depression and schizophrenia (Cochrane reviews)
Good: music-assisted interventions in procedural pain, anxiety and dementia-related agitation
Promising but thinner: many other claims
config.why: The credibility strategy is precisely to know this gradient and to match interventions to the evidence.

activities.anchor: music therapy is not a soft subject for musicians
activities.caption: true or false — what the profession actually is
activities.name: mtProfessionJudge

statements.s: Music therapy is an allied-health profession with accredited degrees and a certification exam.
statements.why: Accredited programs, a board exam testing clinical knowledge, documentation standards, supervision — and an evidence base it critiques honestly.

statements.s: It is classical music piped into wards.
statements.why: The musician's skill is real and required — but it is applied inside a clinical framework.

statements.s: The musician's skill becomes optional once you understand the science.
statements.why: The musician's skill is real and required — applied inside the clinical framework.

activities.anchor: matched just above the patient's natural cadence
activities.caption: set the beat — how far above the natural cadence
activities.name: mtRasPlace

config.prompt: RAS lends the damaged oscillator an external timer. On this scale of 'percent above the patient's natural cadence', where does the therapeutic beat sit? (The worked session sets it roughly ten percent above.)
config.why: Beats matched just above the natural cadence pull walking rhythm, stride length and velocity toward it — not by strength, but by lending the damaged system an external timer.

activities.anchor: the singing that surfaces in dementia means the memory has come back
activities.caption: find the faulty line — the dementia claim
activities.name: mtMemorySpot

config.prompt: A student's summary of the dementia phenomenon contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: Play a person with advanced dementia the music of their youth and a whole person appears — singing, reminiscing, self-identifying.
The playlist relieves and reveals; its effects are measured and documented like any other intervention.
The singing means the memory has come back — the pathology is reversing.
What returns is a state, not a restored store — the song comes back while names and dates stay gone.
config.correction: What returns is a state, not a restored store: episodic recall (names, dates, this morning) remains gone while the song returns.
config.why: The playlist relieves and reveals; it does not reverse the pathology — which is exactly why its effects are measured and documented.

activities.caption: bet before you read on — the repertoire question
activities.name: mtGenrePredict

config.q: Which music engages reward and memory circuitry most strongly, the research finds?
choices: Familiar and preferred music — the patient's own playlist
Any music, as long as it is played quietly
config.why: Familiar and preferred music engages reward and memory circuitry most strongly — a patient's own playlist is often the clinical optimum. The genre is chosen by the goal and the person, never by fashion.

activities.anchor: The professional literature distinguishes music therapy
activities.caption: drag the divider — therapy versus music medicine
activities.name: mtEvidenceCompare

config.prompt: Two channels, different evidence pools — drag the divider:

before.label: Music medicine
before.text: Recorded music offered by medical staff — a real intervention, but pooled separately in the literature.

after.label: Music therapy
after.text: Delivered by a therapist, interactive, goal-directed — assessment, intervention, measured outcome.

config.why: Their evidence pools differ — pooling them is how popular articles overclaim. Knowing which is which is part of the discipline's craft.
